name: sen_sero_sistr
description: SISTR antigen database: O/H antigen panel with its formula table
attribution: SISTR (Salmonella In Silico Typing Resource), PHAC-NML (https://github.com/phac-nml/sistr_cmd), database SISTR_V_1.1.3_db (Zenodo record 15078586, Apache-2.0). Converted to gspec format.
note: Converted by gspec's scripts/salmonella/import_upstream.py from https://zenodo.org/records/15078586 (retrieved 2026-11-09). The antigen references and the O:H1:H2 formula table are the upstream project's data, converted to gspec/v1 records and gspec.serotype/2; gspec claims no authorship of the content and does not imply upstream endorsement of this conversion.

references.citation: Yoshida CE, Kruczkiewicz P, Laing CR, Lingohr EJ, Gannon VPJ, Nash JHE, Taboada EN. The Salmonella In Silico Typing Resource (SISTR): an open web-accessible tool for rapidly typing and subtyping draft microbial genomes. PLoS One. 2016;11(8):e0160528.
references.note: SISTR: the antigen references and the O:H1:H2 formula table this database was converted from.

references.citation: Grimont PAD, Weill FX. Antigenic formulae of the Salmonella serovars (Kauffmann-White-Le Minor scheme), WHO Collaborating Centre for Reference and Research on Salmonella, Institut Pasteur.
references.note: The antigenic-formula scheme the table encodes; bracket and parenthesis notation in the tokens is the scheme's.

caveats: Converted upstream data: see `attribution` for the upstream project, version and URL.
Antigen determination is a ranking step: a margin below the measured gap between near-identical alleles is required, so re-calibrate after an upstream refresh.
41 upstream serovar rows were dropped at conversion because no reference allele can reach their formula: Aarhus, Aesch, Antarctica, Australia, Barry, Bilu, Borreze, Buckeye, Bulovka, California…
